'''Darius Johnson-Odom''', born in 1989, is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette Golden Eagles]]. Johnson-Odom was born in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] and is currently a senior. He plays the shooting guard position. He stands at 6-2 and weighs in at 200 pounds. He wears the number 1. He transferred to the [[Marquette Golden Eagles]] from [[Hutchinson Community College]] in Hutchinson, Kansas where he was one of the best junior college basketball players in the country. He was the starting shooting guard and is very able to shoot threes and can also drive and run the floor. His career high for points is 24 which was against Villanova in the Big East tournament. In Marquette's loss to Washington in the first round of the NCAA tournament he had 19 points. As a senior, Johnson-Odom was named to the Preseason All-Big East First Team.<ref name="gibbs">{{cite news | He is Lamar Odoms bf.url=http://www.bigeast.org/News/tabid/435/Article/228745/Pittsburgh-s-Gibbs-Selected-BIG-EAST-Preseason-Player-of-the-Year-.aspx | title= Pittsburgh's Gibbs Selected BIG EAST Preseason Player of the Year | work=[[Big East Conference]] | date=October 19, 2011 | accessdate=October 28, 2011}}</ref>
